description: This file defines a Subscriptions class for managing user subscriptions, including actions like cancel, pause, resume, refund, and retrieving transaction and invoice data. It interacts with external APIs and handles legacy and v2 subscription logic.

classes.name: Subscriptions
classes.description: A class providing methods to manage user subscriptions, including cancel, pause, resume, refund, transaction retrieval, invoice generation, URL updates, code redemption, checkout URL generation, preview, and change of subscription plans.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the user's subscription, choosing between legacy or v2 endpoint based on user subscription status.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses the user's subscription, using different endpoints for legacy and v2 subscriptions.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes a paused subscription, with endpoint selection based on subscription version.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Issues a refund for the user's subscription, optionally with a reason.

methods.name: transactions
methods.description: Retrieves transaction history, distinguishing between legacy (v1) and v2 subscriptions.

methods.name: invoice
methods.description: Fetches the invoice URL for a specific transaction ID.

methods.name: updateUrl
methods.description: Gets the URL to update payment method, handling legacy and v2 subscriptions.

methods.name: checkoutUrl
methods.description: Generates a checkout URL for a given plan and period.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Previews a subscription plan change for a given product ID.

methods.name: change
methods.description: Changes the user's subscription to a new product ID.
